cards.ex: The old town is steeped in history; every corner tells a story.
cards.exUz: Eski shahar tarixga to'la; har bir burchak bir hikoya aytadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p tarixiy voqealarga ega bo'lgan joy yoki narsa.

cards.ex: Her book offers a fresh perspective on the standard historical narrative.
cards.exUz: Uning kitobi standart tarixiy hikoyaga yangi nuqtai nazarni taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish voqealarini bayon etuvchi hikoya yoki rivoyat.

cards.ex: Some historians accuse him of historical revisionism to suit his political agenda.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi tarixchilar uni siyosiy maqsadlariga moslash uchun tarixni qayta ko'rishda ayblashadi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy faktlarni yangi dalillar asosida qayta talqin qilish.

cards.ex: The war marked a dark chapter in history.
cards.exUz: Urush tarixda qorong'u sahifa bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixning muhim bir qismi yoki davri.

cards.ex: They buried a time capsule filled with objects representing life in 2023.
cards.exUz: Ular 2023-yildagi hayotni ifodalovchi narsalar bilan to'ldirilgan vaqt kapsulasini ko'mdilar.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlar uchun yaratilgan tarixiy narsalar to'plami.

cards.ex: Their family's roots run deep in this community.
cards.exUz: Ularning oilasining ildizlari bu jamiyatda chuqur.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq o'tmishga borib taqaladigan, mustahkam asosga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The city is a vibrant cultural mosaic, with people from all over the world.
cards.exUz: Shahar butun dunyodan kelgan odamlar bilan jonli madaniy mozaika.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar va urf-odatlarning aralashmasi.

cards.ex: There's no historical precedent for such a radical change.
cards.exUz: Bunday keskin o'zgarish uchun tarixiy pretsedent yo'q.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va hozirgi vaziyat uchun namuna bo'ladigan voqea.

cards.ex: The debate over cultural appropriation continues to be heated.
cards.exUz: Madaniy o'zlashtirish haqidagi bahs qizg'in davom etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir madaniyat elementlarini boshqa madaniyat tomonidan ruxsatsiz qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The museum is a vital link to the past for future generations.
cards.exUz: Muzey kelajak avlodlar uchun o'tmish bilan muhim bog'liqlikdir.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish davr bilan bog'lovchi narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: They still practice the age-old tradition of pottery making.
cards.exUz: Ular hali ham qadimiy kulolchilik an'anasini davom ettirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan an'ana.

cards.ex: Studying history gives you a broader historical perspective on current events.
cards.exUz: Tarixni o'rganish sizga hozirgi voqealarga nisbatan kengroq tarixiy nuqtai nazarni beradi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani tarixiy kontekstda tushunish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Cultural sensitivity is crucial when working in a diverse environment.
cards.exUz: Har xil muhitda ishlashda madaniy sezgirlik juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa madaniyatlar va urf-odatlarga hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: His achievements are forever recorded in the annals of history.
cards.exUz: Uning yutuqlari abadiy tarix yilnomalarida qayd etilgan.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy voqealarning yozma xotiralari.

cards.ex: The battlefield is considered hallowed ground by many.
cards.exUz: Jang maydoni ko'pchilik tomonidan muqaddas joy deb hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy yoki diniy sabablarga ko'ra muqaddas hisoblangan joy.

cards.ex: Some politicians try to rewrite history to justify their actions.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi siyosatchilar o'z harakatlarini oqlash uchun tarixni qayta yozishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy faktlarni o'zgartirish yoki soxtalashtirish.

cards.ex: Immigrants often face pressure to undergo cultural assimilation.
cards.exUz: Immigrantlar ko'pincha madaniy assimilyatsiyadan o'tish bosimiga duch kelishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir madaniyatga singib ketish jarayoni.

cards.ex: His legacy lives on through his charitable foundation.
cards.exUz: Uning merosi xayriya fondi orqali yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi odamning ta'siri yoki xotirasi davom etadi.

cards.ex: Many ancient languages have been lost to time.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab qadimgi tillar vaqt o'tishi bilan yo'qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan unutilgan yoki yo'qolgan.

cards.ex: The founding fathers envisioned a nation built on freedom and equality.
cards.exUz: Asoschi otalar ozodlik va tenglikka asoslangan davlatni tasavvur qilishgan.
cards.uzDef: Davlat yoki tashkilotni asos solgan shaxslar.

cards.ex: The invention of the internet marked a new era in communication.
cards.exUz: Internetning ixtiro qilinishi aloqada yangi davrni belgiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqea yoki o'zgarish orqali davrni ajratib ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We must keep alive the memory of those who fought for our freedom.
cards.exUz: Biz ozodligimiz uchun kurashganlarning xotirasini jonli saqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xotirani yoki an'anani saqlab qolish.

cards.ex: The danger of historical amnesia is repeating the mistakes of the past.
cards.exUz: Tarixiy xotirasizlikning xavfi o'tmish xatolarini takrorlashdir.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni unutish yoki e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

cards.ex: They carry on the traditions of their ancestors with great pride.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z ajdodlarining an'analarini katta faxr bilan davom ettirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: An'analarni saqlab qolish va kelajak avlodlarga yetkazish.

cards.ex: His decisions significantly shaped the course of history.
cards.exUz: Uning qarorlari tarix yo'nalishini sezilarli darajada o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy voqealarga katta ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Immigration has enriched the cultural fabric of the country.
cards.exUz: Immigratsiya mamlakatning madaniy to'qimasini boyitdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatni tashkil etuvchi madaniy elementlar yig'indisi.

cards.ex: His art perfectly captured the spirit of the times.
cards.exUz: Uning san'ati davr ruhini mukammal aks ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir davrdagi asosiy g'oyalar va e'tiqodlar.

cards.ex: The statue is a monument to the soldiers who died in the war.
cards.exUz: Haykal urushda halok bo'lgan askarlarga yodgorlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining yoki voqeaning xotirasiga bag'ishlangan yodgorlik.

cards.ex: He had a brush with history when he met the president.
cards.exUz: U prezident bilan uchrashganda tarixga tegish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy voqea yoki shaxs bilan qisqa vaqt ichida bog'liq bo'lish.

cards.ex: The ruins are evidence of a once-thriving ancient civilization.
cards.exUz: Xarobalar bir paytlar gullab-yashnagan qadimgi tsivilizatsiyaning dalilidir.
cards.uzDef: Qadimda mavjud bo'lgan va o'z madaniyati bilan mashhur bo'lgan jamiyat.
